Management has implemented plans to both increase its revenues from the sales of its products and to achieve cost savings within the next year, sufficient to generate positive operating cash flow levels.
In August 2024, the Company implemented the Restructuring Plan to consolidate manufacturing operations resulting in cost savings.

The Company has realized and plans to continue to realize direct material cost savings by concentrating efforts on driving gross margin improvement through various methods such as pricing actions, continued mix shift towards the Restore and Rejuvenate collections, and by driving cost savings through supply chain initiatives and manufacturing efficiency.

Further, management’s plans include additional actions intended to improve liquidity and reduce costs, including a planned optimization of advertising spending, pacing the number of new store openings, efforts to mitigate tariff impacts by managing the country of origin, and other cost-saving initiatives.
